lines.text: Welcome to Waymark. I’m Nour; I light the lamps here. This line always says what to do next.
Up top: your level, your gold and gems, and your streak, the days in a row you’ve met your daily goal.
Every building is a place you can go into. I’ll show you each one when it’s useful.

lines.intro:board: The Notice Board has today’s quests. Finish them for gold, and a chest now and then.
lines.intro:fellowship: Your friend is in town. The letterbox in Your House opens the Fellowship: see what they’re up to.
lines.intro:market: You’ve earned enough for something at the Market. Have a look.
lines.intro:wardrobe: New gear goes on in Your House: open the cupboard.
lines.intro:other-hall: The other hall’s door is open too, whenever you’re curious.
lines.intro:arena: Up at the Arena, friends challenge each other. Yours might be waiting.
lines.intro:ledger: The desk in Your House keeps a ledger of how far you’ve come, and the shelf your trophies.
lines.intro:decorate: You have something new for your room. In Your House, tap Decorate and set it wherever you like.

board.title: The Notice Board
board.text: Today’s quests and daily goal are posted here, with the contracts that pay gold. Chests you’ve earned wait on the shelf.

market.title: The Market
market.text: Five wares are set out each day, the same for everyone. Gold buys gear for your traveler, furniture for your room, or a gift for a friend.

house.title: Your House
house.text: This room is yours: tap the floor to walk. The cupboard holds your wardrobe, the shelf your trophies, the desk your ledger, and the letterbox the Fellowship.

arena.title: The Arena
arena.text: Challenge a friend to beat your score, or take on one they’ve sent you. A challenge waits a week for its answer.

chapters.title: Finding your way
chapters.text: The line at the top of the square always says the one thing to do next. Each guild has a road, a story walked one step at a time, and the line follows the guild you practiced last. Every building is open: go in whenever you like.

chapters.title: The Notice Board
chapters.text: Today’s quests and your daily goal are posted here. Each day brings three contracts, small tasks in the guilds that pay gold; finish all three for a chest. Chests wait on the shelf until you open them.

chapters.title: The Market
chapters.text: Five wares are set out each day, the same for everyone: gear for your traveler from {cheapestWare} gold up, a dye, a streak shield, and something for your room: furniture, a wallpaper or a floor. You can also buy a ware as a gift for a friend.

chapters.title: Your House
chapters.text: Your own room: tap the floor or use the arrow keys to walk, and tap a piece to use it. The cupboard dresses your traveler, the desk keeps your ledger, the shelf your trophies, and the letterbox the Fellowship. Decorate moves anything in the room and sets out the furniture, wallpapers and floors you own; Done keeps it, Cancel puts it all back. A room holds up to {floorPieces} pieces on the floor and {wallPieces} on the wall, and the way from the door must stay open. Friends can visit and walk around your room, but only you can change it. A friend who visits can leave you a note in your letterbox, and you can leave one in theirs: a few words of Arabic or Morse, one a day.

chapters.title: The Fellowship
chapters.text: Friends you invite are here, with what they’ve been up to. Invite someone from Settings: they make their own account and are your friend at once. Friends stand in the square, and tapping one visits their house: their room as they arranged it.

chapters.title: The Arena
chapters.text: Challenge a friend to beat your score, or take on one they’ve sent you. A challenge waits a week for its answer.

chapters.title: XP and levels
chapters.text: Every lesson and drill earns XP, and XP raises your level. Reaching a level pays {goldPerLevel} gold times the level, every {xpPerGold} XP earns a gold coin, and every {gemEveryLevels}th level brings a gem.

chapters.title: Gold and gems
chapters.text: Gold buys gear, furniture and streak shields at the Market. Gems are rarer: one every {gemEveryLevels}th level, one in the daily chest on every {streakGemEvery}th day of a streak, and some for achievements. Nothing costs gems yet.

chapters.title: Your streak
chapters.text: The streak counts the days in a row you’ve met your daily goal. A streak shield saves it on a day you miss: it costs {shieldPrice} gold at the Market, and you can hold {maxShields}. Days 7, 30 and 100 of a streak each bring a chest.

chapters.title: The daily goal
chapters.text: Choose how many minutes to practice each day, from {goalMin} to {goalMax}: tap the goal in the top bar to change it. Reaching it pays the daily chest, {dailyChestGold} gold, with a gem on every {streakGemEvery}th day of a streak.

chapters.title: Ranks and achievements
chapters.text: Each guild has ranks, earned as you walk its road and pass its trials. Achievements are milestones across Waymark: they pay gems, and some give a title to wear under your name.
